summary.key_theme: Apple 在美國擴大製造布局與 AI 策略進展，但面臨地緣政治壓力（中國晶片限制）及市場對硬體定價與競爭的擔憂。

bullish.title: Apple says $60 billion of its U.S. investment push is going to Texas
bullish.reason: Apple 宣布在德州投入 600 億美元進行製造與供應鏈在地化，有助於降低對海外供應鏈的依賴並強化品牌形象。

bullish.title: Ross Gerber Says 'Now Is a Good Time' to Buy iPhone 17 as Apple Prepares for Potential Price Hike With Next Model
bullish.reason: 分析師看好 iPhone 產品週期與潛在的定價策略調整，認為目前是進場布局的時機。

bullish.title: Maryland tax court voids digital ad tax, orders refunds to Apple, Google and Peacock TV
bullish.reason: 馬里蘭州法院裁定數位廣告稅無效，對 Apple 等科技巨頭而言是潛在的稅務成本節省利多。

bullish.title: Apple Makes Crucial Move in China AI Race
bullish.reason: Apple 積極布局中國 AI 市場，試圖填補 iPhone 在當地競爭力缺口，對維持市占率至關重要。

bullish.title: Apple considering publisher partnerships to add more news & information to Siri
bullish.reason: 透過與出版商合作強化 Siri 功能，有助於提升 AI 助理的實用性與用戶黏著度。

bearish.title: US presses Apple to avoid Chinese memory chips amid shortage
bearish.reason: 美國政府施壓 Apple 停止採購中國記憶體晶片，這將導致供應鏈成本上升並面臨地緣政治風險，選此篇作為代表是因為其涵蓋了後續多篇相關報導的核心衝突。

bearish.title: Apple Stock Stalls as Jefferies Cuts Target to $263.66
bearish.reason: Jefferies 下調目標價，主因是零組件成本上升及 iPhone 定價空間受限，反映市場對獲利能力的擔憂。

bearish.title: Google’s new Pixel 11 puts Gemini at center of AI phone battle with Apple
bearish.reason: Google 透過 Pixel 11 與 Gemini AI 積極挑戰 Apple 的手機市場地位，加劇了硬體與 AI 軟體的競爭壓力。

bearish.title: KeyBanc Has Message For Apple Stock Investors
bearish.reason: KeyBanc 指出短期需求信號雖強，但長期成長的可持續性仍面臨結構性挑戰。

neutral.title: Sandisk, Micron, Coherent, Boeing, Apple, Amazon, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
neutral.reason: 僅為市場概覽報導，未針對 Apple 提供具體基本面分析。

neutral.title: Assessing Apple's Performance Against Competitors In Technology Hardware, Storage & Peripherals Industry
neutral.reason: 屬於行業競爭力評估報告，內容較為中性且缺乏即時催化劑。
